assumptions: Wheel centers retain V7: CAD X=+-126mm, hence track252mm. Width27mm is user-confirmed; original CAD assumed26mm.
Rigid frame mass, COM, inertias and friction are estimates, not weighed or identified from experiments.
Caster mounting height59mm and wheel40x22.5mm follow user drawing.17mm trail is inferred. Pivot height and internal fork are simplified.
C1 scan uses nominal10Hz,500samples,0.05..12m. Ideal simulated rays do not reproduce black-target6m limit, sunlight, real reflectivity or2.5D output.
C1 case60x60x45mm and scan-plane offset33mm are provisional envelopes. Exact manufacturer mounting holes are not designed here.
Camera FOV90deg and15fps are placeholders.2.8mm focal length does not determine FOV without sensor size or calibration. Ideal pinhole images do not prove real lens distortion.
Camera body36x36x11mm,total height45mm,base38x25mm follow user drawing. Actual USB plug and wire routing are not modeled.
Simulation controller is an ideal differential drive, not the STM32 M2006/C610 PI/current-control implementation.
